character_description: Young adult male in his late 20s, warm and cultured tone, measured and steady pacing, scholarly and refined quality, intellectual confidence with a hint of mystery, professional Chinese voice actor style. Studio-quality recording.
audition_line: 这件青铜鼎的锈色沉淀得很均匀，铭文的刻痕深浅一致，应该是战国晚期的器物。各位，古董鉴赏讲究的是耐心，急不得，慢慢看，真相自然会浮出水面。
